mechanism: Betamethasone may increase venlafaxine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction and enhance CNS side effects; venlafaxine may increase glucocorticoid-related adverse effects including hypertension and hyperglycemia.
action: Monitor blood pressure, glucose levels, and mood/psychiatric symptoms; consider venlafaxine dose adjustment if betamethasone therapy is prolonged; avoid unnecessary concurrent use when possible.
